documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) at Virginia Tech (College of Engineering)
documents.date_or_term: undated; page notes later university AI governance
documents.stance_why: The page tells the college community to 'Explore and experiment with AI cautiously' under conditions (no sensitive data, verify output, document use), which is permission with conditions; for student use it only says 'Instructors should establish guidelines'.
documents.summary: A short College of Engineering IT page listing guidelines for AI in academic and administrative work: use cautiously, protect sensitive data, verify output, document use, plus example uses and a note that instructors set student guidelines. It says the university's own AI governance has since overtaken it.

notes: Coder A. The OUAI syllabus page (vt-1) says AI detector evidence 'may be included in a report' while TLOS (vt-2) says the OUAI 'does not accept AI detection reports as a form of evidence'; both coded as written. The framework (vt-3) is a recommendation report, so most units are P54/P65/P70/P80-type governance statements and many are 'will' or 'should' commitments, coded as informs. No computing-unit or course documents were screened in.
